name: textbook-workshop
description: Turn existing resources into a deeply taught textbook and a verified runnable learning companion.

interface.longDescription: A reusable textbook-authoring workflow for existing PDFs, websites, notes, and code. Establishes learner prerequisites, audits sources, sequences concepts, writes substantial textbook chapters with worked reasoning, builds a runnable browser companion, assembles a single-volume book, and verifies the delivered package. Includes authoring references, templates, assembly and validation scripts, and an executable companion starter. This is an instruction-based plugin that works through the host agent's available tools; it does not add a remote service or subject-specific content library.
defaultPrompt: Create a complete beginner-friendly textbook and runnable companion from these resources.
Expand my short lessons into a deeply taught textbook and keep the runnable companion aligned.
Review this textbook's prerequisites, teaching depth, source coverage, and runnable examples.
